### useAppHeaderRef()

```ts
function useAppHeaderRef(): (element) => void;
```

A ref for the App's own top header row. While the element is mounted and touches
the top of the viewport, toasts open below it; it keeps clear of a header that
wraps, grows on touch or scrolls away. The element also carries
`data-caps-app-header`, so a proof can find it.

#### Returns

(`element`) => `void`
